title: Reborn to Master the Blade: From Hero-King to Extraordinary Squire ♀
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On his deathbed the Hero-King Inglis wishes to live again for himself as a warrior; his patron goddess sends his soul into the far future, where Inglis is reborn as the daughter of a minor noble family. Found ineligible for knighthood at six, she sets out to become a knight through skill in battle anyway (J-Novel Club blurb via AniList and MU).
life_message: Worth is earned by striving and skill in combat, not by birth or bloodline.
